{{Quote|Rally up, Dead Men! Operation Sunset is underway.|Fideltin Rusk|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Operation Sunset''' was undertaken by the [[Dead Man's Legion]] in order to root up the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] syndicate on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==History==
[[Provost Marshal]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] was in command of the [[Dead Man's Legion]], a military police unit that consisted of criminals forcibly conscripted into service. Under the orders of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Jebevel Madon]], the Dead Man's Legion was deployed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where they claimed part of the [[Ternion Building]] as Republic territory under the [[Makeb treaty]] with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Using that area as a base, Rusk's men pursued members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate that had fled the Legion's campaign against them on Coruscant, and he was engaged in that conflict when he was approached by the [[Alliance Commander]], the leader of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against [[Zakuul]]. Rusk and the Commander confronted the Black Sun leader [[Skadge]], after which the Commander made to them an offer to join the Alliance.<ref name="TOR" />
